# Commands

**Generated. Do not edit.** `cargo run -p game-console --bin dump-state`.

Every command that ran, in order, with the recipe it fired. `S-24`: the third of the four artifacts a person needs to derive the data dump by hand, the others being `catalog.md`, `recipes.md` and `state.md`.

The hierarchy is flattened. `run setup` opens `setup.4x`, which opens others, and a `run` line is not listed - it is where the next commands are kept rather than a move in the game.
